title: Hydraulic shop presses
subtitle: DPM H-frame shop presses 33 – 220 US tons · DPM-K and DK mobile-cylinder presses · AT T-slot die presses · AP garage press brakes · DK-S straightening presses to 441 US tons
about_title: The press every repair shop and fabricator reaches for several times a day
about_text: The machines in this catalogue are NovoTech's premium line: built in Turkey to NovoTech's specification by a CE-certified metal-forming plant with more than 40 years of machine building and exports to over 100 countries, with European hydraulic and electrical components, inspected before shipping, and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts and technical support from NovoTech in Mississauga, Ontario.

A hydraulic shop press presses bearings, bushings and pins, straightens shafts and bar, bends flat bar and short plate and pushes a die for the odd forming job. The DPM series runs from 33 to 220 US tons with two-speed joystick control, a pressure gauge and relief valve; the DPM-K and DK carry a cylinder that slides across the frame so the ram meets the work instead of the work being shifted under the ram; the AT presses have T-slot tables for your own forming, blanking and coining dies; the AP garage-type press brake bends 1/4″ and 3/8″ plate over 40″ and 60″ with its prism die; and the DK-S 3-axis straightening presses from 220 to 441 US tons straighten plates, beams and bar under a moving ram.
